tool_version: Pinned IDA 9.5 ASM and Hex-Rays C; iced-x86 1.21.0, pefile 2024.8.26, Zig 0.13.0; ninth-round: Ghidra 12.2, Capstone 5.0.6; s41: Capstone 5.0.7; s45: Capstone 5.0.6, iced-x86 1.21.0, pefile 2024.8.26, Zig 0.13.0
command: Decode original instructions at the pinned IDA addresses; reassemble with python verify.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig>. Run check-native-coverage.py NATIVE-350 --original <zedstwu.dll>. Run python -B s21/verify-copy.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig> from the submission directory to replay s21. Run python -B s25/verify-copy-high.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig> from the submission directory to replay s25. Run python -B s29/verify-avx-fill.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig> from the submission directory to replay s29. Run python -B s33/check-fill.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s33. Run python -B s37/check-query.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s37. Run python -B s41/check-initializer.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s41. Run python -B s45/check-cutoffs.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s45. Run python -B s49/check-diagnostic.py ORIGINAL ZIG to replay s49.
scope: Legacy entries, original entry point, exports, all runtime anchors and the additional direct branch target at RVA 0x180c0; two copy entries, 128 import thunks and version resource checked independently. Fifth-round evidence includes four reassembled business exports and a cross-DLL data symbol. Ninth-round evidence covers both called hosts, their complete text, direct branches, external calls and RIP operands. Thirteenth-round evidence checks the original calling edges, references and full text of two internal callees. Four dispatch entry/initializer ranges reassembled; both original initializer target sets verified. Three s21 ranges bound and byte-matched, including four computed jumps and three embedded relative-offset tables. The s25 high-capability copy body is byte-matched, with four computed jumps and three embedded relative-offset tables. s29 reassembles the AVX fill branch with four computed jumps and three embedded relative-offset tables. s33 reassembles the AVX-512 fill leaf and shared return with four computed transfers. s37 reassembles the capability query and its unwind entry and checks readiness, indexing, and the initializer target. s41 reassembles the CPUID initializer, initialized vendor and descriptor data,  loader-zeroed records, and the initializer unwind entry. s45 reassembles the cache cutoff writer, its exception directory entry and unwind information, initial cutoff storage and the debug environment key. s49 reassembles the diagnostic reporter and verifies its exception entry, two format strings, formatting buffer zero-fill and CRT import.
limitations: 102 entry gaps and 26 unresolved references remain. The message source and output helpers at RVAs 0x15000 and 0x185b0 still need full static evidence.
